features.title: Friends' live Perpl positions on one chart, with one-signature take-profit suggestions

product_gate.user: Perpl traders who already share positions in Telegram (Perpl group: 10,158 members)
product_gate.buyer: Traders (free); Perpl pays builder fees on routed orders if it issues a builder code
product_gate.job: See what my friends are holding and act on it without screenshots
product_gate.verb: Open the chart, see each friend's real position at their entry price with live PnL, accept a friend's take-profit suggestion in one signature
product_gate.wedge: Positions are read trustlessly from Perpl's Exchange contract, not self-reported screenshots; a friend's TP suggestion becomes a resting close order on your position in one signature
product_gate.direct_alternative: Perpl's own app plus screenshots pasted into Telegram; fomo and Axiom show friends' trades next to a chart on Solana and Hyperliquid
product_gate.new_capability: On Monad and Perpl: verifiable friend positions on the chart for any address, and suggestions from a friend placed on your position as a real order with one signature, which neither Perpl's app nor Telegram can do
product_gate.kill_shot: It is a frontend over Perpl, the risk of 'better UI for an existing venue' is real; fomo already does social chart overlays elsewhere; stop-losses need Perpl's off-chain keeper; builder fees need Perpl's cooperation; US and UK are geo-blocked
evidence: readPosition: 12 mainnet accounts decoded at block 107,515,148, uPnL matches the contract's own price PnL to the cent; 7/7 bun tests pass on re-run
Perpl on DefiLlama: 3.92M USD TVL on Monad, re-read 2026-09-24; Perpl candle API works without a key
Judge Zeel Patel RFP asks for 'perps + social, directly on the chart' with a different visual language
Fork run: open, resting take-profit, close and cancel from our own code, each read back from the Exchange; stop-loss forward reverts SenderIsNotAdministrator
